description: This file defines the JournalEntryRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA repositories to provide data access methods for JournalEntry entities, including custom queries for fetching journal entries based on transaction ID, reversal status, account IDs, office IDs, and entity information.

classes.name: JournalEntryRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for JournalEntry entity with custom query methods for journal entry retrieval and filtering.

methods.name: findUnReversedManualJournalEntriesByTransactionId
methods.description: Finds journal entries that are manual entries, not reversed, and match a specific transaction ID.

methods.name: findNonContraTransactionIds
methods.description: Retrieves transaction IDs that are not associated with a specified contra account ID.

methods.name: findNonReversedContraTransactionIds
methods.description: Finds transaction IDs for a specific office and contra account that are not reversed and have no reversal journal entries.

methods.name: findProvisioningJournalEntriesByEntityId
methods.description: Fetches journal entries based on entity ID and entity type, likely for provisioning purposes.

methods.name: findJournalEntries
methods.description: Retrieves journal entries for a given transaction ID and entity type, ordered by transaction date, creation date, and ID.

calls: Repository methods executing the query annotations
